selected_script.angle: Using standard glass cleaner on a grease-splattered kitchen backsplash just creates a sticky, cloudy blur; Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray immediately cuts the heavy oil film for a clear, residue-free wipe down.
selected_script.hook: Glass cleaner is just going to make that greasy kitchen backsplash worse.

timeline.scene: Close-up showing someone spraying blue glass cleaner on a grease-splattered tile backsplash and wiping, leaving a cloudy, sticky, smeared blur.
The white Liapu spray bottle with yellow label enters. Spray it onto the same greasy tile and wipe it completely clear instantly.
Fast-cut to spraying and wiping a heavily greasy stovetop surface with ease, revealing shiny metal.
Fast-cut to wiping sticky grease off a microwave exterior and buttons.
Fast-cut showing the final effortless wipe down of the kitchen sink edge and counter, leaving a gleaming clean finish.
Product sitting neatly on a sparkling clean kitchen counter. Text/Voice: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'
